The '''tools''' of Matcha Flavoured are the vanilla pickaxe, axe, shovel and hoe, plus two hybrid tools, the [[mattock]] and the [[dolabra]], and several special tools. Stone tools are removed: the tiers run wood, copper, iron, then the alloys. Every tool's stats come from the pack's own recipes, which the pack uses instead of the blocked vanilla recipes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

== Mining levels ==
Instead of the vanilla "incorrect tool" tags, pack pickaxes use their own block tags:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/non_mineable/wood.json}}</ref>
* '''Wood''' gets no drops from hematite, native gold, native silver, diamond ore, sulfur ores, natural lapis lazuli, deepslate or obsidian.
* '''Copper''' gets no drops from diamond ore, native gold or obsidian.
* '''Iron''' gets no drops from obsidian, crying obsidian or ender chests.
* '''Gold''', '''shakudo''' and '''hepatizon''' pickaxes break obsidian without drops.
* '''Diamond''' (35), '''electrum''' and '''adamant''' (55) mine obsidian very fast.
* The '''steel pickaxe''' and most dolabras have no obsidian rule and mine it normally.
Because the pack's pickaxe rules list <code>#minecraft:mineable/pickaxe</code> as a correct tool without a tier check, any pickaxe not listed above gets drops from every other pickaxe block, including ancient debris.

=== Other tools ===
* [[Shears]]: copper, iron, steel and [[Shepherd's Shears|shepherd's shears]].
* [[Compass]]: copper, golden and titanium.
* [[Archeologist's Brush]], [[Hatchet]], [[Rusty Axe]], [[Crook]].

== Removed ==
Stone tools cannot be crafted; their item IDs are reused for steel, shakudo and hepatizon tools.<ref>{{Source|README.md}}</ref>
